# PowerPlay v1.3.1 — Fire TV

*Plex-focused Fire TV app · Fire OS 7/8 · ARMv7*

## Changes in this release

- Preserved series names, season/episode labels, and Plex thumbnails in transferred sequential and shuffled queues.
- Corrected handoff queue presentation without altering playback order, position, or selected media quality.
